channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont
item.description: Two home matches at Claremont—Navan 'A' vs Kildalkey (Grade 2 Mixed) and Navan vs Drumree (Grade 7 Mens) — plus member courts from 9pm and Juvenile Club Night from 6:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium ☕
item.description: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium featuring Grade 4 Mixed: Navan 'B' vs Mullingar 'A', plus juvenile sessions and extra courts for members from 8:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Happy Diwali Celebration at Navan Badminton Club
item.description: Join Navan Badminton Club in celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights. Embrace the joy, diversity, and community spirit that make our club special.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium!
item.description: Join us for another exciting Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium. All skill levels are welcome for an evening of fun, sport, and banter!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for another exciting Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium. Last chance to register for a Meath League team and watch our juveniles make their grand return!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Navan Badminton Club 2025 AGM
item.description: Join us for the 2025 Annual General Meeting (AGM) of Navan Badminton Club on Wednesday, 13th August at 8 PM in Claremont Stadium. Your participation and input are highly valued.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Eid Mubarak from Navan Badminton Club
item.description: Wishing our community a joyful Eid Al-Fitr as Ramadan ends. Here's to happiness and togetherness!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🎉Season's Greetings from Navan Badminton Club!
item.description: Join Navan Badminton Club in celebrating a joyful festive season and reflecting on our 2024 achievements. Here's to an exciting 2025!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Join Us at Claremont Stadium Tonight!
item.description: Enjoy a night of exciting badminton matches and freestyle play at Claremont Stadium. Don't miss the action!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Thursday Badminton Fun!
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for Beginner Club Night from 9pm to 11pm. Open to all skill levels with courts for team games and open play.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🎾🏸 Game Night Announcement
item.description: Join us for our first home match of the new season. Exciting matches await with Navan 'A' vs Skryne starting at 8pm. Come and cheer for our team!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Shuttle Time!
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for some shuttle action! All ages welcome. Sign up by Friday, 20th September to join a team. Juvenile Club returns tonight!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Save the Date: Annual General Meeting!
item.description: Join us on 21st August 2024 at 8pm in Claremont Stadium for our Annual General Meeting, just before the new season kicks off! Everyone's welcome!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
